correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives h prime=beta+2lambda*y. At lambda=0 the stated constraint forces beta>=0, making global decrease impossible. For lambda>0 the derivative is increasing and crosses at most once from negative to positive; negative-beta minimum alpha-beta^2/(4lambda) is nonnegative. Substitution at (3,-.05,0) gives H(y)=3y-.025y^2, h(60)=0, H(120)=0 and H(121)<0, so the formal f(61)<0 and F(121)<0. This is a universal algebraic case split on unbounded y>0; direct numerical checks only corroborate. No reassessment of unrelated model estimation results.
